description_en: Claims that postal voting in Germany is systematically manipulated. Spikes before every election; erodes trust in the democratic process itself.

label_en: Migrants get more benefits than pensioners
description_en: False comparisons between asylum-seeker benefits and pensions, usually built on cherry-picked or invented numbers. Fuels resentment against both groups.
Pseudo-scientific claim that wind farms dry out the land and cause droughts. Used to attack the energy transition.
Claims the EU will abolish cash (often '2027') and force a surveillance currency via the digital euro. Misrepresents actual EU legislation.
Claims that WHO treaties or German law will reintroduce mandatory vaccinations. Misreads the WHO pandemic accord.
